objectives.note: skill-base.sh skill_postflight_update: returns update-task-status.sh exit verbatim, annotates only exit 6. command-gate-out.sh: exit 4 and 6 have arms; any other nonzero prints a generic WARNING and claims nothing; its post-redeploy retry does the same. reconcile-task-status.sh: both implement call sites (lines 685 and 745) exit with the code, except exit 4. lib/redeploy-checkpoint-lib.sh: a nonzero reconcile exit is outcome refused; promotion is keyed on the promoted line. orchestrate-stage5-postflight.sh: discards the return code and still calls completion propagation (the same behaviour it has for exit 6); it writes no completed status itself and no script, skill or command calls it. orchestrator-postflight.sh: research and plan only, non-blocking WARNING, no live caller. No caller claims a completed status after exit 7; no edit made outside the two declared files.
